calibration.frame: u = x cos(rotation) + z sin(rotation); w = -x sin(rotation) + z cos(rotation)
calibration.method: Continuous piecewise axis mapping, based on the existing baked plan orientation and nav capture positions. Coordinates use a 1952 x 1277 reference size; the original PNG is rendered at that size.
calibration.note: Illustrated plan is not surveyed geometry. Room1 includes the anchae wing; Room2 is the sarang wing. Kitchen and bathroom geometry have no surveyed control points. Tune axis knots against on-site landmarks if greater accuracy is needed. Do not reuse with a different scene coordinate frame.
